source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.8, printed pages 194-197.

blocks.text: Osmoregulation woh amal hai jis se jandar apne andar pani aur ghule hue maddon (dissolved substances) ka tawazun (balance) ek jaisa qaim rakhta hai, chahe bahar ka mahol kaisa bhi ho. Bohat se samundari jandaron ko is ke liye kisi khaas nizam ki zaroorat nahin parti, kyun ke un ke cells ka osmotic pressure samundar ke pani jitna hi hota hai. Lekin kuch jandaron ko apne andar pani aur minerals ka tawazun rakhne ke liye khud koshish kar ke pani ya namak (salts) lena, rokna ya nikalna parta hai.
